judge_input.description: If there happens to be a crash earlier on in the course of the session, we currently do not correctly upload the logs to the server the way we should. Because those logs never make it up, this whole situation makes it much more difficult to troubleshoot what actually went wrong. To fix that, from now on we will always upload the crash logs, while at the same time we will still continue to honor whatever record settings the user has specified.
